# ToolMaster Pro

> ToolMaster Pro provides free browser-based tools for text, PDF, image, video, developer, SEO, marketing, calculator, generator, and business workflows. Most tools run in the user's browser without signup.

ToolMaster Pro is organized around practical utility pages. Use the links below for canonical navigation, policies, and representative high-value tools.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://toolmaster.cloud/): Overview of the ToolMaster Pro online tool collection.
- [All Tools](https://toolmaster.cloud/tools/): Browse the full tool directory.
- [Blog Guides](https://toolmaster.cloud/blog/): Tutorials and workflow guides.
- [About](https://toolmaster.cloud/about/): Site background and tool philosophy.
- [Contact](https://toolmaster.cloud/contact/): Contact page for support, feedback, and requests.

## Tool Categories

- [AI & Content Tools](https://toolmaster.cloud/category/ai-content/): AI writing, rephrasing, captions, and content helpers.
- [Image Tools](https://toolmaster.cloud/category/image-tools/): Browser-based image conversion, compression, editing, and OCR tools.
- [Developer Tools](https://toolmaster.cloud/category/developer-tools/): Formatters, validators, encoders, minifiers, and API utilities.
- [PDF Tools](https://toolmaster.cloud/category/pdf-tools/): PDF merge, split, compress, convert, and extract tools.
- [SEO & Marketing Tools](https://toolmaster.cloud/category/seo-marketing/): Metadata, sitemap, keyword, and content-analysis tools.
- [Calculators](https://toolmaster.cloud/category/calculators/): Finance, health, time, and unit calculators.
- [Text Tools](https://toolmaster.cloud/category/text-tools/): Word counting, conversion, sorting, diffing, and text cleanup tools.
- [Video Tools](https://toolmaster.cloud/category/video-tools/): Video trimming, compression, conversion, and GIF tools.

## Representative Tools

- [Word Counter](https://toolmaster.cloud/tools/premium-plus-word-counter/): Count words, characters, reading time, and text statistics.
- [JSON Formatter](https://toolmaster.cloud/tools/json-formatter/): Format, validate, and minify JSON.
- [Text to Speech](https://toolmaster.cloud/tools/text-to-speech/): Convert text to speech using browser and system voices.
- [Background Remover](https://toolmaster.cloud/tools/background-remover/): Remove image backgrounds in the browser.
- [PDF Merger](https://toolmaster.cloud/tools/pdf-merger/): Merge PDF files locally in the browser.
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolmaster.cloud/tools/qr-code-generator/): Generate QR codes for links, text, and contact data.

- [Privacy Policy](https://toolmaster.cloud/privacy-policy/): Privacy and data-handling information.
- [Terms of Service](https://toolmaster.cloud/terms-of-service/): Terms for using the site.

- [Disclaimer](https://toolmaster.cloud/disclaimer/): Scope and limitations of tools and information.
- [DMCA Policy](https://toolmaster.cloud/dmca/): Copyright and takedown information.

## Discovery Files

- [Sitemap](https://toolmaster.cloud/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL list for crawl discovery.
- [Robots.txt](https://toolmaster.cloud/robots.txt): Crawler access rules.
- [Ads.txt](https://toolmaster.cloud/ads.txt): Authorized digital seller declaration.
